finding: Clef description moderation hit the server eight-second deadline. The shared failure blocked all three generation requests with HTTP 503 before allowance reservation or image-provider submission.

confidence.failureMechanism: Confirmed directly by correlated moderation and HTTP invocation logs.
confidence.appleAttribution: High confidence: fresh build-8 session advertising Darwin/27.2.0, matching Apple review software, failed at 00:58:01 UTC, 235 seconds before the 01:01:57 UTC rejection email. Logs do not explicitly identify the operator as Apple or establish device hardware.

causalChain: Production App Attest enrollment and three signed request assertions passed.
The three generation requests shared one batch safety assessment.
The Clef assessment did not return a usable result within the fixed 8000ms deadline.
Account cached that moderation_unavailable outcome for the batch; all three callers received HTTP 503.
The request path exits before /reserve, so no image-provider submission or sheet allowance debit occurred for this batch.
expectedServerMessageFromDeployedSource: The description safety check is temporarily unavailable. No sheet allowance was used. Please try again later.
uiMessageLimitation: The server response body and actual device screenshot were not captured in these logs; the message above is derived from the deployed source path.

compatibilityAssessment.conclusion: The matching session successfully used registration and App Attest on iOS 27.2. Its failure was an intermittent moderation availability failure, with no evidence of an app/backend protocol mismatch.
compatibilityAssessment.earlierSameFailure: The local investigation from 22 October recorded Clef eight-second timeouts before the most recent backend deployment.
compatibilityAssessment.currentSuccess: The earlier 31 October build-8-protocol Sunburst test passed; its production moderation check logged 360ms.

deeperProviderCause: Unknown. The timeout proves the local eight-second deadline expired; retained evidence does not distinguish provider queueing, model inference latency, transport delay or Gateway delay. Gateway collection was disabled for moderation by collectLog:false.
recommendedRemediation: Make the moderation path tolerate transient slowness with a bounded total deadline and a carefully bounded retry of the text-only safety check before returning a batch-wide failure. Retain safety assessment and existing thresholds.
Avoid treating transient moderation availability errors as long-lived batch decisions when implementing recovery; ensure all three concurrent callers share one recovery attempt.
Add a regression that simulates a slow/transient Clef response and verifies eventual moderation approval, one image reservation per generation, and no duplicate image submissions.
Verify on the submitted build-8 protocol and a physical TestFlight device before resubmitting. The diagnosed mechanism is in the backend, so a backend-only fix may work with build 8.
validation: 33 complete session events below the 1000-event query limit; assertions verified one eight-second timeout, three shared batch failures, three successful assertions, successful enrollment, and zero reservation calls.
changesMade: Read-only Cloudflare log queries and local evidence updates. No app code, backend settings, deployments, provider calls, credentials or App Review messages changed.
